title: Aasmaan Mein 96 · Ep 1 · Ghadi
sources: Zeta Galaxy app (Ace My Exams: day-by-day plan, hardest topic first; Exam insights: 104 board papers 2023-26, 6 Maths chapters ≈ 52% of marks)

lines.text: Jis raat datesheet aayi... aasmaan mein ek ghadi ug aayi.
lines.caps: JIS RAAT | *DATESHEET AAYI... | AASMAAN MEIN | EK *GHADI | UG AAYI.

lines.text: Laal. Chamakti hui. Aur us par likha tha... chhiyanve.
lines.caps: LAAL. | CHAMAKTI HUI. | AUR US PAR | LIKHA THA... | *96.

lines.text: Chhiyanve din. Pehle paper tak.
lines.caps: *96 DIN. | PEHLE *PAPER TAK.

lines.text: Shehar ka har bachcha jaanta hai... jab ye zero pe pahunchti hai, wo aata hai.
lines.caps: SHEHAR KA | HAR BACHCHA | JAANTA HAI... | JAB YE | *ZERO PE | PAHUNCHTI HAI, | *WO AATA HAI.

lines.text: Examiner.
lines.caps: *EXAMINER.

lines.text: Wo har ghar ka darwaza khatkhatata hai, aur sirf ek sawaal poochta hai.
lines.caps: WO HAR GHAR KA | DARWAZA | *KHATKHATATA HAI, | AUR SIRF | *EK SAWAAL | POOCHTA HAI.

lines.text: Jo jawab de deta hai, wo aage badh jaata hai. Jo nahi de paata... uska dimaag blank ho jaata hai.
lines.caps: JO JAWAB | DE DETA HAI, | WO AAGE | BADH JAATA HAI. | JO NAHI | DE PAATA... | USKA DIMAAG | *BLANK | HO JAATA HAI.

lines.text: Aarav apne Rohan bhaiya ko sabse zyada maanta tha.
lines.caps: *AARAV APNE | ROHAN *BHAIYA KO | SABSE ZYADA | MAANTA THA.

lines.text: Wahi cycle sikhate the, wahi raat ko kahaniyan sunate the.
lines.caps: WAHI *CYCLE | SIKHATE THE, | WAHI RAAT KO | *KAHANIYAN | SUNATE THE.

lines.text: Pichhle saal unki ghadi bhi ugi thi. Aur wo hanste the... abhi toh bahut time hai.
lines.caps: PICHHLE SAAL | UNKI *GHADI | BHI UGI THI. | AUR WO | HANSTE THE... | ABHI TOH | *BAHUT TIME | HAI.

lines.text: Har raat... kal se pakka.
lines.caps: HAR RAAT... | *KAL SE | PAKKA.

lines.text: Aur ek raat... darwaze pe dastak hui.
lines.caps: AUR EK RAAT... | DARWAZE PE | *DASTAK HUI.

lines.text: Aaj bhaiya Aarav ke saamne baithe hain... par use pehchaante tak nahi.
lines.caps: AAJ BHAIYA | AARAV KE SAAMNE | BAITHE HAIN... | PAR USE | *PEHCHAANTE | TAK NAHI.

lines.text: Aaj raat, bhaiya ka purana phone achanak jal utha.
lines.caps: AAJ RAAT, | BHAIYA KA | PURANA *PHONE | ACHANAK | *JAL UTHA.

lines.text: Usme ek plan tha. Har din ka mission. Sabse mushkil chapter sabse pehle, jab dimaag fresh ho.
lines.caps: USME EK *PLAN THA. | HAR DIN KA | *MISSION. | SABSE *MUSHKIL | CHAPTER | SABSE PEHLE, | JAB DIMAAG | *FRESH HO.

lines.text: Aur ek naksha. Pichhle saalon ke papers se: Maths ke sirf chhe chapters mein... aadhe marks.
lines.caps: AUR EK *NAKSHA. | PICHHLE SAALON | KE PAPERS SE: | MATHS KE SIRF | *6 CHAPTERS | MEIN... | *AADHE MARKS.

lines.text: Bhaiya ke paas sab tha. Bas... unhone kabhi shuru nahi kiya.
lines.caps: BHAIYA KE PAAS | SAB THA. | BAS... | UNHONE KABHI | *SHURU | NAHI KIYA.

lines.text: Wahi plan chahiye? Comment karo... har comment pe main ye plan bhejunga.
lines.caps: WAHI *PLAN | CHAHIYE? | *COMMENT KARO... | HAR COMMENT PE | MAIN YE PLAN | *BHEJUNGA.

lines.text: Tabhi... khidki ke bahar kuch hila.
lines.caps: TABHI... | KHIDKI KE BAHAR | KUCH *HILA.

lines.text: Ghadi ne ek din kaat diya. Pachanve.
lines.caps: GHADI NE | EK DIN | KAAT DIYA. | *95.

lines.text: Ab Aarav ke paas do raaste hain. A: aaj raat hi pehla mission. Ya B: bhaiya ki tarah... kal se pakka?
lines.caps: AB AARAV KE PAAS | *DO RAASTE HAIN. | *A: AAJ RAAT HI | PEHLA MISSION. | YA *B: BHAIYA | KI TARAH... | KAL SE PAKKA?

lines.text: Tum hote toh? Comment karo A ya B. Kal pata chalega... Aarav bachta hai ya nahi.
lines.caps: TUM HOTE TOH? | COMMENT KARO | *A YA *B. | KAL PATA | CHALEGA... | AARAV *BACHTA | HAI YA NAHI.
